listing.title: Another Year Sweeter Shirt, Watercolor Birthday Cake Tee, Vintage Cake Birthday Shirt, Cherry Cake Shirt, Birthday Gift for Her
listing.description: A vintage layer cake painted in watercolor: pale pink frosting piped with cream shells, swags and rosettes, sugar pearls and fine string loops, a red satin bow, glossy cherries and five striped candles lit for a wish, on a mint milk-glass cake stand between two wrapped presents, with confetti and gold sparkles. "Another Year Sweeter" is painted above and below in berry pink. No age, name or date, so it suits any birthday.
